fields.passwordRule: At least 10 characters. A few unrelated words work well.

validation.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address. Check for typing mistakes.
validation.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
validation.businessNameRequired: Enter the name of your shop.
validation.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits shown in your authenticator app.
validation.recoveryRequired: Enter one of your recovery codes.

errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is not correct.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Wait {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} and try again.
errors.lockedNoTime: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.invalidTotp: That code is not right, or it was already used. Wait for the next code and try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Open your shop's dashboard and till.

notice.passwordReset: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.
notice.verified: Email confirmed. You can sign in now.
notice.invitationAccepted: Your account is ready. Sign in with the password you just chose.

unverified.title: Confirm your email first
unverified.body: We sent you a link when you signed up. Open it, then sign in.
unverified.resent: If that address can be used, a new link is on its way.

totp.title: Enter your two-step code
totp.hint: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for {brand}.
totp.useRecovery: Phone lost? Use a recovery code
totp.recoveryHint: One of the codes you saved when you switched on two-step sign-in. Each works only once.

signup.title: Create your shop account
signup.subtitle: Free for 14 days. No card needed.
signup.terms: You can sign in as soon as you confirm your email address.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: If {email} can be used for a new account, we have sent a link to confirm it. The link works for 24 hours.
sent.spam: Nothing there after a few minutes? Look in the spam folder, or try again with the correct address.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.successBody: Your account is ready. Sign in to set up your shop.
verify.failedTitle: This link has expired or was already used
verify.failedBody: Links work once and for 24 hours. Enter your email and we will send a new one.
verify.missingBody: Open the link from your email again, or request a new one below.
verify.resent: If that address can be used, a new link is on its way.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email you signed up with. We will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If {email} has an account, a reset link is on its way. It works once and for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: You will be signed out on every device, then you can sign in with the new password.
reset.invalidTitle: This link has expired or was already used
reset.invalidBody: Reset links work once and for 30 minutes. Ask for a new one.
reset.missingBody: Open the link from your email again, or ask for a new one.

security.title: Account security
security.subtitle: Your password, two-step sign-in and the devices signed in to your account.

password.heading: Change password
password.hint: You stay signed in here. Every other device is signed out.
password.wrongCurrent: That is not your current password.

devices.heading: Signed-in devices
devices.hint: If you do not recognise one, sign it out and change your password.
devices.failed: We could not load your devices.

totp.heading: Two-step sign-in
totp.offBody: Ask for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app each time you sign in. A stolen password alone then cannot open your account.
totp.onBody: Two-step sign-in is on. You are asked for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in.
totp.step1: Open an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy or 1Password), choose to add an account by typing a key, and enter this key:
totp.step2: Then type the 6-digit code the app shows to switch it on.
totp.recoveryBody: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They are shown only now. Write them down or store them in a password manager.
totp.disableBody: Enter your password and a current code (or a recovery code).

invite.title: Join your team
invite.subtitle: You have been invited. Choose a password to start.
invite.invalidTitle: This invitation has expired or was already used
invite.invalidBody: Invitation links work once and for 7 days. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
invite.missingBody: Open the link from your invitation email again, or ask for a new invitation.
invite.signIn: Already have your password? Sign in

Owner.title: Owner dashboard
Owner.subtitle: Sales, stock and profit across your branches will appear here.

status.heading: System status
status.unreachableHint: Start the API (see the dumbbill-backend README) and reload this page.
status.problem: The server answered with a problem

sample.heading: Preview of the dashboard
sample.notice: Sample figures for layout only. Not real data.

Pos.title: Point of sale
Pos.searchHint: Scan a barcode or search by name
Pos.empty: Nothing in the bill yet. Scan or pick an item.

totals.heading: Bill
totals.previewNote: Preview only. The server calculates the final bill, discounts and GST.

retailers.heading: Retailers
retailers.emptyHint: Businesses appear here once they sign up.
